I am an avid R programmer. In this section I share code and material that I have found useful for my research, along with links to other helpful websites containing code and data.

## My Datasets and Code

- **International Asset Pricing Factor Dataset** — asset pricing factor portfolios for ten countries from 1993 to 2017 (built from Datastream data). The factors are created using book-to-market, price-to-earnings, investment, momentum, profitability, and quality characteristics. Refer to [this paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S016517651830168X) for more information. *These factors are no longer updated.*

## Free Data Sources for Research

### Asset Pricing and Factors

<ul class="resource-list">
<li><a href="https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html">Ken French Data Library</a> — the classic US and international factor portfolios, industry returns, and portfolio sorts.</li>
<li><a href="https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets">AQR Data Sets</a> — factor, style, and strategy return series (value, momentum, quality, betting-against-beta, and more).</li>
<li><a href="http://www.econ.yale.edu/~shiller/data.htm">Robert Shiller's Online Data</a> — long-run stock market series, CAPE, earnings, and US home prices.</li>
</ul>

### Firm Fundamentals and Financial Data

<ul class="resource-list">
<li><a href="https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/data.html">Aswath Damodaran's Data</a> — cost of capital, betas, country risk premiums, and industry-level financial data.</li>
<li><a href="https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/companysearch">SEC EDGAR</a> — company filings (10-K, 10-Q, and more); bulk financials in the <a href="https://www.sec.gov/dera/data/financial-statement-data-sets">Financial Statement Data Sets</a>.</li>
<li><a href="https://data.nasdaq.com/">Nasdaq Data Link</a> — a large catalogue of free macroeconomic and financial time series.</li>
</ul>

## Websites and Other Useful Material

Useful material for academics in Economics, Finance, and/or Accounting.

### Readings / Websites

<ul class="resource-list">
<li><a href="https://econjwatch.org/">Econ Journal Watch</a> — a nice collection of articles with critical takes on topics of academic interest.</li>
<li><a href="https://critical-finance-review.org/">Critical Finance Review</a> — critical papers on finance; a must-read for Finance/Accounting academics.</li>
<li><a href="https://statmodeling.stat.columbia.edu/">Andrew Gelman's Blog</a> — causality, Bayesian statistics, and statistical pitfalls in pop-science research.</li>
</ul>

### Datasets and Code

<ul class="resource-list">
<li><a href="https://jkpfactors.com/">JKP Factors</a> — asset pricing factor data for many countries from Compustat Global.</li>
<li><a href="https://www.openassetpricing.com/">Open Source Asset Pricing</a> — data on asset pricing factors plus code for generating factors from CRSP/Compustat.</li>
</ul>

### Data Science and Programming

<ul class="resource-list">
<li><a href="https://www.tidy-finance.org/">Tidy Finance</a> — the best way to learn R programming for financial analysis and research.</li>
</ul>
